# Synthetic test fixtures for Mimir scanner unit tests.
# These tokens match the regex patterns but are NOT real credentials —
# they use obvious fake patterns (FAKE/TEST in the name) and are clearly
# synthetic. The AWS key format requires AKIA + 16 chars from [A-Z2-7].

# aws-access-token rule: AKIA prefix + 16 uppercase alpha/2-7 chars = 20 chars total
aws_access_key_id = AKIAFAKEKEYABCDE2345
aws_secret_access_key = AKIATESTKEY234567AB
